**v1.11.1: the battle simulator plans the hit the bot plans - the best one it can pay for -, boosts with no hit in hand, and past "Boosts before each hit" while no hit can be paid for - as the bot does.**
- **What was wrong.** The simulator (the boss deck pick, the planner, the zone deck) played three things otherwise than the bot:
  - **The hit it plans.** The simulator planned the strongest hit in hand whether or not it could pay for it, put the boosts on for that one, and held back a hit it could pay for while one 1.5 times stronger waited for its pips - a rule of its own, since v1.0.0. With "Hit first (fast)" too it cast only that planned hit, so a Thunder Snake it could pay for stayed in hand while a Storm Lord waited for its 7 pips. The bot plans, of the hits in hand it can pay for, the one that deals the most with the blades on and in hand (the traps too with `solotraps` on) - only with none paid for, the strongest of them all - and casts it: after its boosts with "Boost first, then hit", at once with "Hit first (fast)". So whenever it can pay for a hit, one goes; it holds one back only to save pips for a hit that ends the battle ("Save pips for a finishing hit", `pipsave`). And the simulator played an item card's hit (the wand's) like any other - planned when it dealt the most, the boosts going onto it. The bot never plans the wand's hit: it casts it only when no other hit goes, and not while it would use up a blade or trap on you meant for the planned hit.
  - **No hit in hand.** The simulator cast no blade, trap or aura then: it passed, or cast Tower Shield, an absorb that costs no pips or a Reshuffle. The bot boosts for your school's hit then - your school's trap and blade, the Elemental / Spirit one of your school, Feint, Hex, Balanceblade, Bladestorm and your school's aura, in its usual order.
  - **"Boosts before each hit" (`boostmax`).** The simulator stopped boosting once that many boosts had gone since the last hit, even with no hit in hand it could pay for - it passed while a Storm Lord waited for its 7 pips. The bot holds its boosts back only while a hit can go, so it boosts on while it waits: there's nothing else to do. And the simulator counted only the boosts that landed, where the bot counts each one that went out (it can't see a fizzle) and starts the count again at any hit that went out, a fizzled one too.
- **What changes.** The simulator now plays all three as the bot does. It plans the hit the bot plans - of the hits in hand it can pay for, the one that deals the most with the blades and traps in hand that can still go counted, else the strongest of them all - and casts it as the bot does: with "Hit first (fast)" any hit it can pay for goes at once, the best of them. An item card's hit goes only when no other hit or boost does, and not onto a blade or trap meant for the planned hit. With no hit in hand it casts the boosts for your school's hit (none with your school not known, as before). With `boostmax` set it boosts on past it while no hit in hand can be paid for, and it counts the boosts at the click, as the bot counts them. Nothing changes in the game: the bot plays its cards as it always has, there is no new setting, and the AutoFarmer sends the helper nothing new.
- **A party's Blader or Healer plays as before**: it always boosted for the hitter's hit, with no limit, and cast its own hit, the best it can pay for, only after its boosts. In the team plan, the hitter it boosts for now plans and casts its hits as above.
- **Measured on the same dice** (2000 battles a cell, each battle on the same seed in v1.11.0 and v1.11.1): v1.11.0's wizard and enemies - a Storm wizard (a Balance one for the Hydra decks, a Fire one for the Fire Cat + Hydra deck) with 3000 health and 60% damage against a 6000-health boss or 3 mobs of 1500 health (2-pip hits of 150-200 and 100-150 that always land), "Boost first, then hit". % won v1.11.0 -> v1.11.1 with `discardspent` on (this AutoFarmer's default), then with `reboost` on; in brackets, the battles only v1.11.1 won / only v1.11.0 won. First with `boostmax` 0 (the default).
  - **Decks with one kind of hit** - the planned hit is the same either way, so only the boosts with no hit in hand play a part:
    - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 97.0% -> 97.6% (+12 / -1); 96.8% -> 99.8% (+59 / -0); with `discardspent` off 89.1% -> 93.7% (+91 / -0). 3 mobs: 44.1% -> 44.5% (+15 / -7); 75.3% -> 77.7% (+47 / -0).
    - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 3 Storm Aura: the boss 82.0% -> 81.5% (+10 / -20); 85.5% -> 95.3% (+198 / -0). 3 mobs: 60.2% -> 60.2% (+21 / -20); 71.3% -> 78.8% (+149 / -0). With `reboost` on, each hit lets the boosts it fits go again, so a hand with no hit has more to cast.
    - Decks heavy in boosts, with few hits, where a hand with no hit comes up often. 3 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 3 Storm Aura + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap (a boost cast with no hit in hand in 39.5% of the battles against the boss): the boss 48.6% -> 61.1% (+279 / -30); 50.5% -> 81.6% (+622 / -0); with "Hit first (fast)" 32.8% -> 42.4% (+221 / -29). 3 mobs: 11.6% -> 13.3% (+58 / -24); 19.2% -> 32.1% (+257 / -0). 4 Storm Lord + 2 Feint + 4 Stormblade + 4 Elemental Blade + 4 Storm Trap + 2 Bladestorm: the boss 82.8% -> 82.5% (+36 / -42); 75.7% -> 94.0% (+366 / -0). 3 mobs: 10.1% -> 10.2% (+26 / -22); 46.0% -> 57.0% (+218 / -0). Balance: 4 Hydra + 4 Elemental Blade + 4 Balanceblade + 4 Bladestorm + 3 Sharpened Blade (with no hit in hand, the boosts for a Balance hit: Balanceblade and Bladestorm, not Elemental Blade): the boss 32.3% -> 36.0% (+87 / -13); 63.1% -> 72.4% (+186 / -0). 3 mobs: 3.1% -> 3.1% (+4 / -3); 45.0% -> 51.1% (+123 / -0).
    - Balance: 8 Hydra + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 2 Balanceblade + 3 Sharpened Blade: the boss 88.7% -> 89.2% (+9 / -0); 95.0% -> 95.4% (+8 / -0). 3 mobs: 40.2% -> 40.4% (+3 / -0); 50.0% -> 50.1% (+3 / -0).
    - 8 Storm Lord + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap at 40% (or 4 Elemental Trap) + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 96.5% -> 97.2% (+14 / -0) (97.2% -> 98.0%, +14 / -0); 98.1% -> 99.3% (+25 / -0) (98.5% -> 99.7%, +25 / -0). 3 mobs: 45.9% -> 46.5% (+12 / -0) (47.7% -> 48.3%, +12 / -0); 75.0% -> 76.2% (+22 / -0) (77.2% -> 78.3%, +23 / -0).
    - The same battles, battle for battle, with `discardspent` on, with `reboost` on, with "Hit first (fast)" and with `discardspent` off: 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade (the boss 92.2%, 3 mobs 34.2% with `discardspent` on); 8 Storm Lord + 1 Stormblade + 1 Sharpened Blade; 8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade. With these a hand with no hit and a boost to cast hardly ever comes up. 8 Storm Lord + 3 Bladestorm + 3 Storm Aura + 3 Stormblade: the same battles with `discardspent` on and with `reboost` on, the same number won with the other two (1991 to 1997 of 2000 battles the same).
  - **Decks with a cheap hit and a big one** - the planned hit is now the one you can pay for, and most of them win less, which is how the bot plays them: it casts a Thunder Snake (or a Storm Shark) every round it can pay for one, so its pips rarely reach the Storm Lord's 7. v1.11.0 held each Thunder Snake back while a Storm Lord in hand waited for its pips (with the first deck below, a Thunder Snake now goes in about 9 rounds of a battle against the boss, 7.5 against 3 mobs, where v1.11.0 held it back).
    - 10 Thunder Snake + 6 Storm Lord + 4 Sharpened Blade (no blade, so the same with every setting): the boss 76.2% -> 64.2% (+294 / -533), 3 mobs 18.9% -> 6.8% (+104 / -344).
    - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Thunder Snake + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap: the boss 82.7% -> 73.4% (+250 / -435); 94.1% -> 92.7% (+107 / -136). 3 mobs: 73.0% -> 20.5% (+69 / -1119); 79.5% -> 41.5% (+153 / -913); with "Hit first (fast)" 73.2% -> 21.8% (+96 / -1124).
    - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Storm Shark (3 pips) + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade: the boss 95.5% -> 90.7% (+73 / -168); 98.1% -> 98.2% (+36 / -35). 3 mobs: 65.2% -> 10.2% (+41 / -1140); 79.3% -> 31.4% (+99 / -1057).
    - 4 Storm Lord + 4 Tempest + 3 Stormblade + 3 Storm Trap + 2 Feint + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap (against the boss, the 6-pip Tempest is now the plan while the Storm Lord waits for its 7): the boss 96.7% -> 95.8% (+42 / -59); 97.2% -> 97.9% (+41 / -26); with "Hit first (fast)" 93.0% -> 90.2% (+91 / -147). 3 mobs, where the Tempest deals the most anyway: 91.0% -> 91.9% (+18 / -1); 90.7% -> 91.9% (+24 / -0).
    - 4 Thunder Snake + 2 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade: the boss 1.9% -> 0.3% (+5 / -35); 25.2% -> 30.1% (+355 / -257). 3 mobs: 0.0% -> 0.0%; 0.3% -> 0.1% (+2 / -6).
    - Fire: 6 Fire Cat (1 pip) + 4 Hydra (8 pips) + 4 Fireblade + 3 Elemental Blade wins next to nothing either way: 0.0% -> 0.0% with `discardspent` on; with `reboost` on, the boss 7.8% -> 0.1% (+1 / -155), 3 mobs 8.8% -> 2.6% (+48 / -170).
    - One that wins more: 6 Storm Lord + 4 Fire Cat (1 pip) + 4 Stormblade + 2 Fireblade - the Fire Cat it can pay for is now the plan, and the Fireblade goes on it. 3 mobs: 58.6% -> 75.7% (+593 / -251); 70.0% -> 68.4% (+383 / -415). The boss: 72.8% -> 72.8% (+369 / -369); 78.7% -> 80.5% (+329 / -293).
    - The bot's "Save pips for a finishing hit" (`pipsave`, 3 rounds by default) isn't in the simulator: the bot holds the cheap hit back while the big one, once it can pay for it, would end the battle. So with decks like these the simulator can come out low near a battle's end.
- **With `boostmax` set the numbers move a lot** (`discardspent` on, all of v1.11.1 together), and if you set it, the boss deck pick and the zone deck may come out differently. The bot, and now the simulator, boosts on past `boostmax` while the hit in hand waits for its pips, where v1.11.0 passed (with the first deck below, in 4 battles of 5). So `boostmax` 1 no longer spreads the blades over the hits while a hit waits for its pips - the bot doesn't spread them either. Against mobs, v1.11.0 made `boostmax` 1 look up to twice as good as 0 with the 8 Storm Lord decks; with v1.11.1 it wins within about 5 points of 0, and most decks win less against mobs than with v1.11.0. Against a boss, and with a Hydra, it mostly wins more now, sometimes far more.
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against 3 mobs, `boostmax` 1: 58.5% -> 34.5% (+77 / -556); `boostmax` 0 wins 34.2%. v1.11.0 put the plain and the sharpened Stormblade on two Storm Lords, one each; now both go on the Storm Lord that waits for its 7 pips. Against the boss 92.2% -> 92.2% (+57 / -56). `boostmax` 2: the same battles (one blade slot: never more than two boosts a hit).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap, `boostmax` 1: the boss 94.8% -> 97.8% (+94 / -36), 3 mobs 88.6% -> 48.7% (+57 / -855); `boostmax` 2: the boss 96.8% -> 97.7% (+36 / -18), 3 mobs 71.8% -> 48.5% (+98 / -566). With `reboost` on too, `boostmax` 1: the boss 68.2% -> 99.9% (+635 / -0), 3 mobs 70.8% -> 89.5% (+487 / -114).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade, `boostmax` 1: the boss 96.4% -> 98.1% (+62 / -28), 3 mobs 93.5% -> 52.0% (+23 / -852). 8 Storm Lord + 3 Bladestorm + 3 Storm Aura + 3 Stormblade, `boostmax` 1: the boss 92.5% -> 94.8% (+132 / -86), 3 mobs 84.5% -> 67.0% (+165 / -515).
  - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 3 Storm Aura, `boostmax` 1: the boss 74.0% -> 81.5% (+375 / -226), 3 mobs 74.2% -> 58.0% (+245 / -570); with `reboost` on too, the boss 33.7% -> 94.0% (+1237 / -31), 3 mobs 47.6% -> 86.2% (+877 / -105).
  - The Tempest + Feint deck above, `boostmax` 1: the boss 83.0% -> 93.6% (+310 / -99), 3 mobs 77.5% -> 92.8% (+391 / -86).
  - Balance: 8 Hydra + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 2 Balanceblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against 3 mobs, `boostmax` 1: 0.0% -> 45.4% (+907 / -0) - v1.11.0 passed while each Hydra waited for its 6 pips with one blade on it, and lost every battle; `boostmax` 2: 38.5% -> 44.6% (+343 / -221). Against the boss, `boostmax` 1: 82.0% -> 87.8% (+276 / -159).
  - The boost-heavy decks above, `boostmax` 1: the 3 Storm Lord deck, the boss 5.8% -> 47.0% (+892 / -69), 3 mobs 15.4% -> 13.4% (+212 / -251); the Feint + Bladestorm deck, the boss 58.8% -> 80.7% (+618 / -181), 3 mobs 62.5% -> 22.0% (+154 / -965); the 4 Hydra deck, the boss 0.0% -> 3.2% (+64 / -0), 3 mobs 0.0% -> 17.1% (+342 / -0). With `reboost` on too: the boss 1.6% -> 66.7%, 15.2% -> 90.5% and 0.0% -> 51.0%.
  - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Thunder Snake + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap and the Storm Shark deck fall further below v1.11.0 against 3 mobs than with `boostmax` 0: 79.4% -> 22.6% (+78 / -1214) and 80.3% -> 8.8% (+30 / -1462).
  - With "Hit first (fast)" and `boostmax` 1 it's much the same: the 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap deck against 3 mobs 88.0% -> 51.6% (+62 / -789), the Tempest + Feint deck against the boss 82.2% -> 90.2% (+308 / -147).
- **The simulator plays everything else exactly as before**, against v1.11.0: on 270 random decks (9990 comparisons: 8100 simulate, 1350 planner as Hitter, Blader and Healer, 270 team plan and 270 deck pick), every comparison in which none of v1.11.1's changes came into play - no boost with no hit in hand, none past `boostmax` with no hit to pay for, no card fizzled with `boostmax` set, the planned hit always v1.11.0's and no item card's hit at the chain's end - came out the same: 848 of them, 0 differing. The 40 decks with one kind of hit and no item card planned the hit v1.11.0 planned in all 1440 of their comparisons: 15 of them play the same everywhere, and the other 25 differ only where a boost went with no hit in hand or past `boostmax`, or a card fizzled with `boostmax` set (529 comparisons). Most of the random decks hold two or more kinds of hit, or an item card's (230 of the 270), so most of them play differently somewhere, as they should: 8427 of the 9990 comparisons differ, and 18 decks play the same everywhere. Of the 25 decks with no blade, trap or aura, the 5 with one kind of hit and no item card play the same everywhere; 18 of the other 20 differ now (the hit they plan, or the wand's).
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper: its simulator plays this way too - every v1.x AutoFarmer plans the hit it can pay for, holds its wand's hit back this way, boosts with no hit in hand and boosts past `boostmax` while no hit can go. This AutoFarmer with an older helper: that helper's way, as before. The zone deck is worked out once more after updating.
- **Nothing to try in the game.** The bot plays as before, so there is no LIVE_CHECKS step. To compare with the bot, with the game's hand read: debug.log's "plan: ..." line names the hit the bot planned ("plan: no hit: ..." with none in hand) and ends "this round: ..." with the blades and traps it can put up; "wand not cast: it would use up ... meant for ..." says it held the wand's hit back; and "N boosts since the last hit (boostmax M): hitting now" is written only while a hit can go.
- **Still not in it:** saving pips for a finishing hit (`pipsave` - the bot plans that hit, casts no other while it waits and boosts past `boostmax` meanwhile; the simulator never saves pips: the best hit it can pay for goes, and counts as one that can go) - it matters most for decks with a cheap hit and a big one, near a battle's end (not measured); the bot's hit slots (`hit4` only on a boss you picked; of two hits that deal the same, the first of `hit4`, `hit3`, `hit2`, `hit1` - the simulator's the first in hand; a hit the bot learned in no slot, planned only with no slot hit in hand and cast after them - the simulator plays every deck hit as a slot's; with the game's hand not read, the first hit in slot order it can pay for, not the one that deals the most); a pet's or another gear's hit card of your school, which the bot casts as a learned hit in no slot (planned with no slot hit in hand, with "Hit first (fast)" before the boosts, with no wand check; one of another school it never casts) - the simulator plays every item card's hit as the wand's, and doesn't read `usewand`; the traps in the planned hit's damage and in the kill check with `solotraps` off (the default: the bot counts none there; the simulator counts the ones on, and for the planned hit the ones in hand too); a Blader's or Healer's boosts for the hitter's planned hit (the bot's are for the schools of the hit the hitter planned, sent over the party, else the hitter's school; the simulator's for the hitter's hit in hand with the biggest damage); with every hit switched off (`usehit1` to `usehit4` 0) and the game's hand read, the bot's boosts for the strongest hit in that hand (the simulator boosts for your school's); the prism, Attenuate and your school's bubble in the bot's boost chain (the simulator plays none of them); your own PlayerStats.txt %s for Balanceblade, Bladestorm, Hex and Feint (`blade3`, `blade4`, `trap3`, `feint`: the simulator tells those cards apart by the nearest of the defaults, 25, 20, 30 and 70); the enemies' cheats.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
